column2: architectural_guidelines.md testing strategy omits parser smoke verification after the docs edit. scenario: make lint and markdownlint do not enforce the _heading_re grammar in python/architectural_guidelines.py:31; a malformed ### g-* heading (missing colon, wrong id token, or #### depth) can leave a guideline visible in the raw file but absent from architectural-guidelines read parsed output, so /design and /implement would silently miss an entry the acceptance criteria claim was added

plan.txt:52-58 parser smoke verification is incomplete relative to acceptance format (extends accepted finding_1). scenario: the plan adds id-only `rg -f` checks after `architectural-guidelines read`, but `parse_guideline_entries` in `python/architectural_guidelines.py` keeps only lines matching `- why:` and `- deviate when:` exactly. a mistyped bullet (for example `- deviate:` or `- deviate when:`) is silently dropped while the `### g-*` heading still parses, so stdout can show `architectural_guidelines_status=present` and all seven new ids yet `/design` and `/implement` consume entries missing required why or deviate text, violating acceptance that each entry use the existing three-line shape
